ns2:section.sectionText: Fall ME 470 registration is for students whose UIN ends in an even number. To petition a change in this fall registration, please contact the MechSE Undergraduate Programs Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu). You will receive a TIME CONFLICT AND AN APPROVAL ERROR when registering for this course. To receive the necessary overrides to register, please contact the MechSE Undergraduate Programs Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu) .
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Mechanical Sci & Engineering department.
